shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -i theme; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat index.d.ts types.d.ts ThemeProvider.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts useTheme.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts useThemeContext.d.ts useSystemTheme.d.ts constants.d.ts; echo ---JS---; cat ThemeProvider.js useTheme.js useThemeValue.js useThemeType.js; grep -rn "deprecated" . | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; (timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags --json 2>&1 | head -20); echo ---CSS---; grep -n "g-root\b\|g-root {" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head; grep -n -A6 "^\.g-root {" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20; echo ---EXPORTS---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts

mkdir -p /tmp/uikit8 && cd /tmp/uikit8 && timeout 90 npm pack @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; tar xzf gravity-ui-uikit-8.0.0.tgz && ls package; echo ---PEERS---; node -e "const p=require('/tmp/uikit8/package/package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({peer:p.peerDependencies,deps:p.dependencies},null,1))"; echo ---THEME-DIFF---; diff -r /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme /tmp/uikit8/package/build/esm/components/theme --exclude='*.map' | head -80; echo ---CHANGELOG---; sed -n 1,80p package/CHANGELOG.md; ls package | grep -i migr; ls package/docs 2>/dev/null | head

echo ---V8 Provider---; cat /tmp/uikit8/package/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts /tmp/uikit8/package/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.js; echo ---V8 README theme---; grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "^## Theme\|^### Theme\|ThemeProvider" /tmp/uikit8/package/README.md | head -120; echo ---V7 README theme---; grep -n -i -A25 "ThemeProvider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; echo ---ICONS---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -i -E "^(Sun|Moon|Sun2|Monitor|Display)" ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -3
timeout 120 npm install --save --save-exact @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1 2>&1 | tail -3 && grep -n "gravity-ui" package.json && timeout 180 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "---status---"; git status --short; rm -rf /tmp/uikit8

rm -rf dist && timeout 120 npx vitest run --root /home/sandbox/workspace --dir /tmp/smoke --environment node --server.deps.inline="@gravity-ui/uikit" --server.deps.inline="@gravity-ui/icons" "/tmp/smoke/app.smoke.test.tsx" 2>&1 | tail -20

mkdir -p .smoke && sed "s#/home/sandbox/workspace/src#../src#g" /tmp/smoke/app.smoke.test.tsx > .smoke/app.smoke.test.tsx && sed "s#/tmp/smoke/#.smoke/#" /tmp/smoke/vitest.config.mts > .smoke/vitest.config.mts && timeout 120 npx vitest run --config .smoke/vitest.config.mts 2>&1 | tail -20; rm -rf .smoke /tmp/smoke; git status --short
